description: Every query is unique, forcing full pipeline execution (retrieval + privacy filter + LLM generation) with zero cache benefit, to measure honest CPU-bound throughput.
bottleneck_finding: CPU is NOT the bottleneck. Hit Groq free-tier rate limit (6000 tokens/minute) within first 10 fresh requests, causing 500 errors after 429 rate-limit responses. Real ceiling is external API rate limit, not local compute.
changes_made_this_week: Converted LLM client to persistent HTTP connection (httpx.AsyncClient with keepalive) instead of opening new TCP connection per request
Added per-stage latency timing breakdown to /query endpoint (injection check, cache check, retrieval, privacy filter, LLM generation, output scan)
Built dedicated no-cache load test (load_test_fresh.py) using unique queries to measure true generation throughput
next_step: Repeat this same test against the local LLM server (once connection details are provided) to isolate true CPU-bound throughput without external API rate limiting.
